title: The Fake Recipe
author: Sable Ishikawa
blurb: Mirabel Thackeray, the team's statistician who knows the game is rigged, counts days until graduation like a sentence being served. But when a best friend goes missing, leaving only a set of keys behind, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must decide who to be when the labels come off, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
